E-exhibition.item: Exhibition swims: parser flag, additive core field, converter carry, labelled and optional-exclude seeds
E-exhibition.decisions: User: additive core field HistoricalSwim.isExhibition approved. Exhibition seeds are INCLUDED by default with a visible label; exhibitionSeeds:"exclude" drops them. No change to isRankableSwim, bestTimeEligibility.ts or any other reader of bests.
E-exhibition.measured: 128 of 2,390 SCY best rows (5.4%) across the three teams are exhibition. The endpoint returns ONE row per event, so excluding an exhibition best leaves that event with NO seed. Real fixture tests/fixtures/profile_fastest_times-1330318.json has exactly 1 exhibition row (2025-10-10, 100 IM SCY, 53.27).
